summary: Staff Admin API v1 supports token-authenticated post create/update and admin publish/unpublish using the same Editor.js validators as the UI.
detailed_changes: Added staff-owned api_tokens with Bearer auth and newsroom:issue-admin-api-token for bootstrap.
Added /api/admin/v1 posts CRUD plus publish/unpublish with RBAC mirroring the staff editors.
Documented Admin API auth, rate limits, and authorization in docs/api.md.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff and admin API consumers
Internal impact: hashed staff tokens; BlockValidator enforced on API writes
